python -c "
import parse

# R1: Trailing newline
print('=== R1: Trailing newline ===')
p = parse.Parser('{x}')
result = p.parse('hello\n')
print(f'Named field with newline: {result.named if result else None}')

p = parse.Parser('{name:d}\n')
result = p.parse('123\n')
print(f'Typed field with trailing newline: {result.named if result else None}')

# R2: Numeric indices
print('\n=== R2: Numeric indices ===')
p = parse.Parser('{0}')
result = p.parse('hello')
print(f'Simple numeric index: {result.named[\"0\"] if result else None}')

p = parse.Parser('{0:d}')
result = p.parse('123')
print(f'Numeric index with type: {result.named[\"0\"] if result else None}')

p = parse.Parser('{0}:{1}')
result = p.parse('a:b')
print(f'Multiple numeric indices: {result.named}')

# R3: Sign specifiers
print('\n=== R3: Sign specifiers ===')
fmt = parse.extract_format('+10d', {})
print(f'+10d sign: {fmt[\"sign\"]}')
fmt = parse.extract_format('-5d', {})
print(f'-5d sign: {fmt[\"sign\"]}')

# R4: Alignment handling (existing tests pass)
print('\n=== R4: Alignment handling ===')
p = parse.Parser('{:>5}')
result = p.parse('  ab')
print(f'Right align: {result.named if result else None}')

# R5: Datetime functions
print('\n=== R5: Datetime functions ===')
print(f'dt_format_to_regex available: {hasattr(parse, \"dt_format_to_regex\")}')
print(f'get_regex_for_datetime_format available: {hasattr(parse, \"get_regex_for_datetime_format\")}')
print(f'strf_date_convert available: {hasattr(parse, \"strf_date_convert\")}')
print(f'date_convert available: {hasattr(parse, \"date_convert\")}')

# Test datetime conversion
regex = parse.dt_format_to_regex('%Y-%m-%d')
print(f'Datetime regex: {regex.pattern}')

# R6: Parser.format property
print('\n=== R6: Parser.format property ===')
p = parse.Parser('{x:d}')
print(f'Parser.format: {p.format}')

# R7: Variable-length %f in datetime
print('\n=== R7: Variable-length %f ===')
regex = parse.dt_format_to_regex('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')
print(f'%f regex part found: {\"\\\\d{1,6}\" in regex.pattern}')

# R8: Hyphen-minus in field names
print('\n=== R8: Hyphen-minus in field names ===')
p = parse.Parser('{my-field}')
result = p.parse('hello')
print(f'Hyphen field name: {result.named if result else None}')

# R9: Grouping characters in decimal format
print('\n=== R9: Grouping characters ===')
p = parse.Parser('{x:n}')
result = p.parse('1,000')
print(f'Comma grouping: {result.named[\"x\"] if result else None}')
result = p.parse('1_000')
print(f'Underscore grouping: {result.named[\"x\"] if result else None}')
"
